description: Improve the Twilight cast page for its strongest search intent: a useful cast reference and post-Twilight career guide, while removing celebrity-gossip sections.

replacements.old: The Twilight Saga ran from 2008 to 2012 and assembled one of the most memorable ensemble casts of the 2000s. Many of the actors — then largely unknown — went on to major careers. Here is the complete guide to every significant cast member across all five films, what they brought to their roles, and where they are now.
replacements.new:
The Twilight Saga cast includes Kristen Stewart as Bella Swan, Robert Pattinson as Edward Cullen, and Taylor Lautner as Jacob Black, alongside the Cullens, Wolf Pack, Volturi, and the human characters of Forks. The five films were released from 2008 to 2012. Below is a complete cast guide with each actor's character, role in the story, and notable work after Twilight.

Quick answer: The three central Twilight actors are Kristen Stewart (Bella Swan), Robert Pattinson (Edward Cullen), and Taylor Lautner (Jacob Black). The wider cast includes Ashley Greene, Peter Facinelli, Elizabeth Reaser, Kellan Lutz, Nikki Reed, Jackson Rathbone, Anna Kendrick, Michael Sheen, Dakota Fanning, and many others.

replacements.old:
❤️ Relationship Status

Married screenwriter Dylan Meyer on April 20, 2025, in a 170-guest ceremony at Casita Del Campo restaurant in Los Angeles. Stewart called 2025 "the craziest year of my life." The couple have spoken openly about wanting children.

🎬 Current Projects 2026

The Chronology of Water (her directorial debut, Cannes 2025) — 91% on Rotten Tomatoes, 6.5-min standing ovation at Cannes. The Challenger (Amazon, 2026) — plays NASA astronaut Sally Ride. The Wrong Girls (filming 2025) — stoner comedy she wrote and produced. Flesh of the Gods — vampire thriller with Elizabeth Olsen.

🔥 Latest Buzz

Has publicly said she wants to direct a feminist Twilight remake — darker, more complex, her way. The internet is not calm about this.
replacements.new:
🎬 Career after Twilight

Stewart continued building a film career outside major franchises, earning an Academy Award nomination for Spencer (2021). She also moved into directing: The Chronology of Water is her first feature film as director and premiered in Cannes' Un Certain Regard in 2025. Her post-Twilight work shows how far her career expanded beyond Bella Swan.

replacements.old:
❤️ Relationship Status

Engaged to British singer-actress Suki Waterhouse. Together since 2018. Welcomed a baby girl in early 2024 — Rob has gushed about fatherhood: "It's the most fun thing. My kid, you can actually hang with her. She's great." Secret marriage rumours are swirling after a cryptic press-tour moment with co-star Zendaya in March 2026.

🎬 Current Projects 2026

The Drama (A24, April 2026) — romantic thriller with Zendaya, already generating Oscar buzz. The Odyssey (Christopher Nolan, July 2026) — alongside Matt Damon, Anne Hathaway, Tom Holland. The Batman Part II — begins filming April 2026, release October 2027. Dune: Part Three — rumoured role as Scytale.

🔥 Latest Buzz

During The Drama press tour Rob and Zendaya were asked about their biggest secret. Rob turned to her and said "It's the same one that you have" — sparking massive speculation he and Suki secretly married. Neither has confirmed or denied it.
replacements.new:
🎬 Career after Twilight

Pattinson deliberately moved into a wide range of independent and studio films after Twilight, including Good Time, The Lighthouse, and The Batman (2022). He has also worked with directors including Christopher Nolan and Bong Joon Ho, making his post-Edward career one of the most varied among the original cast.

replacements.old:
❤️ Relationship Status

Married Taylor Dome — a registered nurse and mental health advocate — on November 11, 2022, at Epoch Estate Winery, California. In March 2026 they announced their first pregnancy. Both are legally named Taylor Lautner after she took his surname — yes, package delivery is chaotic.

🎬 Current Projects 2026

Taylor Lautner: Werewolf Hunter (Amazon MGM, in development) — he plays a fictionalized version of himself: Hollywood actor by day, actual werewolf hunter by night. Created by Daisy Gardner, directed by Radio Silence. The Squeeze Podcast — weekly mental health and wellness podcast co-hosted with wife Taylor Dome.

🔥 Latest Buzz

Reunited with ex Taylor Swift for her Eras Tour in 2023, appearing in her "I Can See You" music video. The Taylor² reunion broke the internet. He confirmed on Call Her Daddy that yes, Swift ended their 2009 relationship — and he's totally fine with it.
replacements.new:
🎬 Career after Twilight

Lautner stepped back from the blockbuster spotlight after Twilight and has focused on selective acting, podcasting, and wellness work. He also revisited the franchise publicly through fan events and interviews. His post-Twilight career is quieter than Pattinson's or Stewart's, but Jacob Black remains his defining screen role.

replacements.old:
Is Kristen Stewart still acting in 2026?

Yes — more than ever. Kristen Stewart made her directorial debut with The Chronology of Water (Cannes 2025, 91% on Rotten Tomatoes) and is set to star as NASA astronaut Sally Ride in Amazon's The Challenger limited series in 2026. She also stars in Flesh of the Gods alongside Elizabeth Olsen.
replacements.new:
What has Kristen Stewart done since Twilight?

Stewart expanded beyond the franchise with films including Clouds of Sils Maria, Personal Shopper, and Spencer, which earned her an Academy Award nomination. She also directed The Chronology of Water, her first feature film as a director, which premiered at Cannes in 2025.

replacements.old:
Is Kristen Stewart married?

Yes. Kristen Stewart married screenwriter Dylan Meyer on April 20, 2025, in an intimate ceremony in Los Angeles. The couple got engaged in 2021. Stewart has spoken about wanting to start a family.
replacements.new:
What is Kristen Stewart known for besides Twilight?

Beyond Bella Swan, Stewart is known for acclaimed work in films such as Clouds of Sils Maria, Personal Shopper, and Spencer. Her role as Princess Diana in Spencer earned her an Academy Award nomination for Best Actress.

replacements.old:
What is Robert Pattinson doing in 2026?

Robert Pattinson is having one of his biggest years. His A24 film The Drama with Zendaya released in April 2026, Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey arrives July 2026, and he begins filming The Batman Part II in spring 2026. He and fiancée Suki Waterhouse also welcomed a daughter in 2024.
replacements.new:
What has Robert Pattinson done since Twilight?

Pattinson moved into a broad mix of independent and studio films after Twilight, including Good Time, The Lighthouse, and The Batman (2022). His post-Twilight filmography spans arthouse projects, major franchises, and collaborations with filmmakers such as Christopher Nolan.

replacements.old:
Did Robert Pattinson marry Suki Waterhouse?

Still not officially confirmed as of July 2026 — but the rumors intensified when Pattinson was asked on the March 2026 red carpet for The Drama what the biggest secret he's ever kept was, and replied to Zendaya, "It's the same one that you have" — widely read as him hinting at a secret marriage to Waterhouse, not anything romantic between him and Zendaya (who has her own separate marriage rumors involving Tom Holland). Zendaya's stylist Law Roach has publicly claimed at both the SAG Awards and the Oscars that "the wedding has already happened." Pattinson and Waterhouse have been engaged since around 2023 and share a daughter, born 2024.
replacements.new:
Why is Robert Pattinson's post-Twilight career notable?

Pattinson avoided being defined only by Edward Cullen by taking challenging roles in films such as Cosmopolis, Good Time, and The Lighthouse before becoming DC's Bruce Wayne in The Batman. His career is a useful example of how a major franchise actor can move into both independent cinema and blockbuster filmmaking.

replacements.old:
What is Taylor Lautner doing now in 2026?

Taylor Lautner is in development on the Amazon MGM series Taylor Lautner: Werewolf Hunter, where he plays a fictionalized version of himself as a secret supernatural tracker. He and wife Taylor Dome (both legally named Taylor Lautner since her name change) announced their first pregnancy in March 2026.
replacements.new:
What has Taylor Lautner done since Twilight?

Lautner took a lower-profile path after the Twilight films, with selective acting work and a growing focus on wellness and podcasting. Jacob Black remains his best-known film role, and he continues to participate in Twilight fan events and interviews.
